titel: Ep189 How I Prepared for a 40-Song Cover Band Gig

einzeiler: Behind the scenes of prepping a 40-song set list for a professional party band gig
kurzfassung: Desi Cerna shares how he prepared for a three-hour, forty-song cover band gig in Kentucky with the Nashville-based group Party of Five. He details his workflow for organizing charts on an iPad, choosing versatile gear like the Kemper amp and PRS guitar, and handling live improvisations. Along the way, he reflects on the musical value of playing diverse genres and unexpected set list challenges.
stichpunkte: Played a 40-song set list for a private anniversary party in Kentucky with Party of Five
Managed a massive repertoire spanning classic rock, pop, disco, country, and 80s hits
Built a Spotify playlist and organized digital charts in ForScore on an iPad
Utilized a Kemper Profiling Amplifier with 80s Marshall profiles and a Fender Twin Reverb
Played a PRS DGT guitar modified with Seymour Duncan APH-1 pickups and coil-splitting
Overcame weather delays and last-minute set list changes by improvising on the fly
Emphasized the importance of vocal harmonies and backing vocals in professional cover acts

kapitel.titel: The Party of Five Gig and Set List Variety

clips.hook: Why a busy guitarist walked away from the gigging scene for over a decade
clips.text: The speaker explains that starting a teaching business, getting married, having children, and experiencing burnout led to stepping away from live performances in the late 2000s.

clips.hook: How a five-piece band divides vocal duties across multiple members
clips.text: The band consists of four instrumentalists and a dedicated female vocalist, but every instrumentalist contributes backing vocals or leads to protect voices and handle varied vocal ranges.

clips.hook: Modifying a high-end guitar for a more traditional, lower-output sound
clips.text: The host describes swapping out stock pickups on a signature model for vintage-voiced humbuckers to achieve a less distinct and more traditional tonal foundation.

clips.hook: When monsoon rains and outdoor venue chaos derail the entire schedule
clips.text: Severe weather storms forced the band to scramble and add side curtains to the tent to protect gear, delaying dinner and pushing back the vow renewal ceremony.

clips.hook: Discovering unexpected musical gems in contemporary pop radio hits
clips.text: While initially dismissive of a modern pop track, the speaker recognized a clever major pentatonic scale pattern in the guitar part that proved genuinely enjoyable to perform live.

beschreibung:
In this episode, I take you behind the scenes of a recent performance with Nashville-based cover band Party of 5. I share how I prepared for a 40-song setlist, what the band expected from me, how I organized and learned the music, the guitar gear and live rig I used, and what it was like performing the show.
Along the way, I discuss some of the songs and guitar parts I found especially fun or challenging, a few surprises from the gig, and lessons that can help any guitarist become a more prepared, versatile musician.
Whether you're interested in playing live, joining a cover band, or simply learning songs more efficiently, you'll pick up practical tips you can apply to your own guitar playing.
In this episode:
How I prepared for a 40-song cover band gig

Learning a large setlist efficiently

Organizing charts and setlists for live performance

My guitar, Kemper, and live rig

Songs that were especially fun or challenging to learn

What surprised me about the performance
